            candidates.append((len(rows) + len(cols), color, rows, cols))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError('Could not identify grid separator')
    _, separator, row_lines, col_lines = min(candidates)

    # Keep the contiguous lattice span from the first through last marked

    marked_row_indices = [i for i, r in enumerate(row_lines)

    if not marked_row_indices or not marked_col_indices:

    row_lines = row_lines[min(marked_row_indices):max(marked_row_indices) + 1]
